documentation.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, an open-weight (MIT) model from DeepSeek with a 1M-token context, reasoning, tool calling, structured output and image input.
documentation.input_format: OpenAI Chat Completions request body, POST /v1/chat/completions (JSON): model, messages (system, user, assistant and tool roles; text and image_url content parts in user messages), and optional sampling parameters, max_tokens or max_completion_tokens, stop, tools and tool_choice, parallel_tool_calls, response_format (json_object or json_schema), reasoning_effort or reasoning, stream and stream_options. Reference: https://inference.negbeta.com/docs
documentation.output_format: OpenAI chat.completion object: choices[].message with content, reasoning_content (the model's thinking, null when thinking is off) and tool_calls, finish_reason, and usage with prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens. With stream: true, chat.completion.chunk server-sent events, then a usage chunk with empty choices, then data: [DONE]. The response header X-Serving-Region names the region that served the request.
